changelog:
- Command Bar Fluidity: Removed nested curvy search pill; input sits seamlessly inside the command bar surface.
- Clean Tab Switcher: Removed bulky square card on tabs button; replaced with borderless icon and delicate minimalist tab count indicator.
- Premium Hairline Divider: Added sleek vertical hairline divider separating input bar from action buttons.
- Choreographed Expansion: When tapping the input card to enter queries, tabs and 3-dots menu smoothly slide and fade away as the input bar expands across the full width.
